servinfo.title: Description of Ignition Mode Switching Procedure
servinfo.ptxt: Push the engine switch without depressing the brake pedal (A/T model) or clutch pedal (M/T model), and while information display indicates “PLACE KEY FOB ON START SWITCH” for about 10 seconds, place remote controller on the engine switch for about 2 seconds. Through this process, BCM checks remote controller ID code, and permits switching of ignition mode according to operational state of the engine switch only when the code corresponds with the registered code.
